questions.educationalObjective: Prioritize care for a child with autism.

questions.stem: Which parts of the plan should the nurse include? Select all that apply.

options.text: A private, quiet room with dimmed lights

caseStudies.title: Child with autism spectrum disorder in hospital

exhibits.title: Admission
exhibits.body: A 7-year-old child with autism spectrum disorder is admitted for dental surgery under anesthesia. The child speaks in short phrases, covers the ears at loud sounds and eats only plain pasta. The parent says, "He melts down when his routine changes."

rows.label: Sensory
cells: Distressed by bright lights and beeping alarms

rows.label: Behavior
cells: Rocks and flaps hands when anxious

rows.label: Routine
cells: Bath, story and bed at 1930 every night

rows.label: Safety
cells: Has wandered away from home twice

exhibits.title: Admission
exhibits.body: A 14-year-old was admitted after setting a fire in a school trash can. Over a year the teen has set small fires, stolen from stores, skipped school and hurt the family dog. The teen says, "It's not a big deal."

rows.label: On the unit
cells: Took a lighter from a visitor's bag

caseStudies.title: Antisocial personality disorder on a medical unit

exhibits.title: Medical unit
exhibits.body: A 35-year-old client admitted with a leg wound infection has a history of assault and fraud. The client is charming to some staff, demands extra opioids, and tells a new nurse, "The other nurse lets me have two doses. You're my favorite, you'll help me." The client has been seen in another client's room.

rows.label: Pain
cells: Rates 10/10 while laughing on the phone

caseStudies.title: Factitious disorder imposed on a child

exhibits.title: Pediatric unit
exhibits.body: A 4-year-old child has had 11 admissions this year for vomiting and 'seizures' that no one but the parent has seen. Tests are always normal. The parent, a former nursing assistant, is very attentive, knows medical terms well and enjoys the staff's attention. Symptoms stop when the parent is away.

rows.label: Vomiting
cells: Only when the parent is present

rows.label: Siblings
cells: One sibling died in infancy of unexplained causes
